Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner agent made a critical calculation error in balancing the oxygen atoms for Option B. It incorrectly stated that the left side has 10 oxygen atoms (calculating 5 O2 as 10) but failed to correctly sum the oxygen atoms on the right side. For Option B (2CO2 + 3H2O), the right side contains 4 oxygen atoms from CO2 and 3 oxygen atoms from H2O, totaling 7 oxygen atoms. Since 10 (left) does not equal 7 (right), Option B is unbalanced. The Planner prematurely concluded the task was complete and selected the wrong answer without verifying the arithmetic for all elements in the chosen option.
